answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network erects an economic jetty against fake identities by requiring cryptographic stake burning before validation. An attacker registering n identities faces a superlinear quadratic cost function C(n) = k * n^2, turning cheap duplication into an unscalable marble vault of debt. Each forged persona demands burning basalt reserves of base tokens, ensuring the cost to capture consensus scales exponentially beyond any attacker's payoff.
